description: Continue a failed record import from the step it stopped at. Only an import whose `resumable` is true can be resumed - one that failed on stalled, enqueueFailed or unexpected and was started less than 7 days ago. Rows that already have a result are not processed again. Refused when another import is running on the model. Follow it with get_record_import.
name: resume_record_import
title: Resume record import
